'''Nazran''' is close cousin to King [[Alsalam Saeed Almadar]]. He is from [[Arad Doman]].

== Appearance ==
He has a thin black mustache. He is square and deeply brown. He is handsome and has black eyes.

== Activities ==
Using a light [[Compulsion]], [[Graendal]] sends him to deliver a forged letter to [[Rodel Ituralde]] while reporting to him that it is actually from Ituralde's liege lord King Alsalam.
